stage.name: Sailing
stage.description:
The sky is high and the clouds are distant. It's time to get going. And bring your soda!
<Steam Soda Bottle> When defeated, creates Pure White Steam in the surrounding area.

content.name: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home - Retrospection

hot_spring_jolly_rascal.name: Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal'
hot_spring_jolly_rascal.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice on the street, and wants to play with whoever it bumps into. Even though you can't make out its expression from its obscured face, you can tell it's relishing in its delight—listen! It's laughing!
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

hot_spring_wandering_slider.name: Hot Spring 'Wandering Slider'
hot_spring_wandering_slider.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the surfskate shop, so fast that it comes and goes without a trace! Not even the swirling mud or gravel can hinder its slick skating skills!
abilities: Can stack with a Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal' and leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over after combining

fashion_street_robust_heavy.name: Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy'
fashion_street_robust_heavy.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the sports field. It'll be really happy if you throw its 'treasure' back at it. Wait, no! It seem to be holding discuses this time!
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

fashion_street_hyperactive_aviator.name: Fashion Street 'Hyperactive Aviator'
fashion_street_hyperactive_aviator.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. However, it's learned to float around in a group, filling the sky with soft clouds and interrupting the people's leisurely sunbathing.
abilities: Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

fluffy_buddy.name: 'Fluffy Buddy'
fluffy_buddy.flavourText: If these gentle and difficult-to-perceive fluffy critters suddenly appear in front of you, don't be frightened! In the hot springs, atop the white clouds, and in your memories... Will you still think of them years down the line?
abilities: Hidden in map, can be revealed by Carmine Steam or Pure White Steam
When in contact with Carmine Steam, its explosion produces more Carmine Steam on surrounding tiles and dealing Arts damage to nearby allied units
When in contact with Pure White Steam, its explosion produces more Pure White Steam on surrounding tiles and healing surrounding allied units
